resources.string: Preparing your ship and flight log.
Could not read or save data
Check free storage and retry. Data from a newer version needs an app update. Credits and upgrades take effect only after saving.
The progress file was damaged and could not be recovered. A new flight log was created.
Flight paused. Take a breath, then carry on.
STEP 1 / 4 · Touch and drag sideways to begin. The ship follows your drag.
This flight will earn no rewards or records.
Upgrade once. Benefit on every flight.
Short vibration when ship or shield is hit
Stop moving stars and reduce particles
Credits, records, upgrades and tutorial progress will be erased. Audio, motion and language settings stay. This cannot be undone.
Stored on this device. No accounts, ads or internet required.
Drag sideways in the play area. The ship follows drag distance, without jumping to your touch. Dodge falling meteors; movement is horizontal only.
Hits cost 1 armor. At zero, the flight ends. After a hit, the ship flashes and is invulnerable for 1.2 seconds. Difficulty rises every 20 seconds.
◇ Shield: blocks one hit; lasts 8 seconds.
+ Repair: restores 1 armor, up to your maximum.
◷ Slow: meteors move at 60% speed for 5 seconds.
Survival: 10 points/second. Items: 25 points each. Every 20 final points earn 1 credit for ship upgrades. Abandoned flights earn nothing.
Play requires real-time observation and dragging.
Graze meteors to build combos. Pulse to escape. Master your flight and beat your best.
Clear nearby meteors when energy is full

Graze a meteor without touching it to earn points and energy. Chain near misses within 5 seconds. Combos 3 and 6 give ×2 and ×3 bonuses. Armor hits or timeout break the combo. Time and item points are not multiplied.

At full energy, pulse clears meteors within radius 180 and protects for 0.6 seconds. Start with full energy; recharge 3/second, 12 per near miss and 20 per item. Destroyed meteors give no near-miss points.

From second 12, a shower arrives every 18 seconds with 1.6 seconds of warning. Orange marks danger; cyan marks the shower gap. Older meteors may still occupy it. After 20 seconds, some meteors drift sideways.
Survive 30 seconds: +100 points. Graze 5 meteors: +150. Collect 3 items: +100. Each objective pays once, even when not displayed. Final credits include all bonus points.
Survive 30 seconds · 5 near misses · 3 items. Complete all three for 350 bonus points per flight.
Choose one change for the rest of this flight. Time is frozen while you decide. Each type can be chosen once.
Amplifier: pulse radius 180 → 250. Tradeoff: passive energy recharge is 30% slower. Item and near-miss energy stay unchanged.
Daredevil: double near-miss points. Tradeoff: maximum armor −1; current armor is capped at the new maximum.
Focus: combo window 5 → 8 seconds. Tradeoff: newly collected slow items last 20% less time.

At 45, 90 and 135 seconds, pause to choose an upgrade for this flight only; each type once. A 3-second countdown follows. Amplifier: wider pulse, slower recharge. Daredevil: double near-miss points, less armor. Focus: longer combos, shorter slow effects.
STEP 2 / 4 · Drag into an item for effects and energy.
STEP 3 / 4 · Use PULSE at full energy to clear a path.
STEP 4 / 4 · Let a meteor pass close without touching the ship to earn a combo.
You ended with pulse ready. Next flight, use it before you get cornered.
Survive 30 seconds for 100 bonus points. Seek open space and keep away from meteors.
Try 5 near misses for 150 bonus points. Take risks only with an escape route.
Chain 6 near misses within the combo window for a ×3 bonus.
You can afford your next upgrade. Visit the hangar.
%1$d more credits to afford the cheapest next upgrade.
Ship fully upgraded. Try another strategy and beat your best!
Choose your display language. Saved automatically; game progress is preserved.
0–10s only small rocks fall straight; 10–20s middle gap; 20–30 seconds change slots to both sides. Instructions for pulling by action.
Gate opens left–center–right, every 8 seconds; Gate misses repeat after 4s. The focus is on picking up location, not increasing hail.
4 packages on two alternating routes; The rock does not occupy the pick-up line in the guide window.
The stone row has a slot, changing left/right according to the rhythm; There is room to turn around, standing in the middle is not always safe.
Through the 4 centers of the slots, mark the correct rhythm.
Cluster down y=560, assign task pin before each cluster. Click early to be prompted and repeat safely.
Each cluster is completely turned off by one pulse.
Two sample small rock routes, showing practice area, at least 8 opportunities. Collision does not add to the target.
Connect 2, dodge close for 5 seconds, achieve combo 2.
Front shield with two narrow sections; still has a wide outer line so you don\'t need to take the hit.
Shield blocks once, does not lose armor.
Slow graft gate; shows that the item does not slow down the target clock. There are routes that don\'t need to be picked up to slow down.
Pick up 2 slow items with different IDs.
Three stages: collect, change lanes, hold the pulse to open the final path. Acknowledge both goals simultaneously.
At least 3 dodge close to the last gate.
Phase 1 two columns left in the middle; Mix 2 slots to the side and then lower the core. Separate pin/window for each core.
Destroy each core at the beginning of the phase.
Two diagonal branches create a herringbone slit; change direction after each pair, with a straight line indicating a turn.
Left → slightly left → slightly right → right; Teaching small translation continuously. Missed current port loopback.
The two diagonal lines intersect but do not reach the train line at the same time; Line numbering warning comes first.
The corridor changes direction with an arrow; keep the ship\'s momentum. Gate 3 has a break to learn to turn.
Passed all 5 in the opening attempt.
Each pair has a slow kick followed by a fast kick, avoiding false gaps after the first kick.
Avoid each type of speed at least twice.
Kick in a curved arc; The item is in the safe concave area and then changed to the opposite arc, there are 6 chances.
Collect 3 pieces in the first 3 chances.
Two quick rows and then a long break; At the end of the stage, change three rows to avoid sudden rocks entering the ship.
One pulse destroys at least 4 rocks.
Small rocks rotate around large blocks; The orbital slot predicts the pick-up location at the ship row.
Do not destroy the center block.
Wide roads have few things, narrow roads have locks. There are 4 locks, so you don\'t have to take risky routes every time.
The two wings press to create a horizontal slot; After pressing one wing, it stops revealing the core. The final phase reverses the scan with an alarm.
The ship was not hit by a wing mine.
Battery in the middle of a storm
There are 5 batteries behind the poles with slots; must pick up the correct position instead of sending pulses continuously.
The striped area stops responding, the bright area recharges normally. Alternating ports force the choice of staying loaded or switching early.
Pass the last gate with NL ≥70.
The button turns off only within the pulse radius; There are 3 duty batteries. The button that has not been turned off still has a bypass and the next turn.
Turn off all 3 when the safety ring is open.
The port has a number/symbol; only the current port receives progress. Going through the future gate does not subtract lives, does not increase the count.
Do not go through the gate in the wrong order.
Every 10 seconds the pin is on the opposite edge of the next slot. Self-evaluate whether there is enough time to cycle back or remove the battery; The battery removal route always exists.
Collect 3 batteries and still go to the next slot.
Going through the 80 NL drainage station area; There is a 100 refill line in front of each station. The pulse does not replace the station touch operation.
Both stations receive when input NL ≥95.
The ion cloud heals in one lane, but the rock will get there after the warning. Having at least 3 batteries usually makes the secondary target viable.
The mission map drifts to extreme left/right cyclically, with a line predicting the pick-up point. There are 7 opportunities.
Collect 4 pieces in the first 4 opportunities.
Reserve at the end of the road
Through 3 ports, deposit ≥70 into the last port
The first two ports are free; End gate costs appear from the beginning. Battery compensation loops every 8 seconds if missing, has standby line.
The three bright poles take turns; Stand at the correct polarity to open the armor and then use the boss/pulse battery. The last phase has no cooldown but still accepts mission pins.
Opened all 3 poles correctly on first try.
Allies with 3 armor live for 50 seconds
You fly first, signal to change lanes for 2 seconds; the player breaks threatening rocks with pulses. First 10 seconds of low pressure to learn.
Hold the correct pickup area for 1s; The compartment has many rapid drops and touches without repeating.
The rock fell through the line causing the station to lose armor. Big stones give priority to stations, small stones give priority to train lines; Identify dangers that need to be prevented.
No big rocks can get through.
Freight trains rarely change lanes; two waves of incoming drones have pulsed batteries supplied on a scheduled basis.
You follow the player\'s lane 1.2 seconds late; need to change soon. The dotted line represents the delay, no need for a second control finger.
You pass through each gate the slot eccentricity is ≤20 units.
Divide the relief source in half
The station lives and delivers 3 packages
Green package returns to the station, yellow package gives optional money. Have all the main facts; Balance station rescue with profit.
The station has at least 3/4 armor remaining.
The previous/next friend was on the same route but with a time difference; threats have identification warnings, two separate armor bars.
No one will lose more than 1 armor.
Receiving compartment at the break after the rain, 5 rescues are numbered. Must use rest rhythm to pick up.
Do not pick up mines disguised as having warning signs.
Drone locks the player\'s old lane when alerted and then rushes; Lead threats away from you and move on at the right time.
Lead 4 drones into the lane without you.
Breaking 3 cores, the cargo ship is alive
The boss targets players/ships alternately, each series has a target symbol. Block the cargo ship target to open the core.
Only 15–25s and 35–45s have slippage when changing direction; green braking zone before lane change.
Do not touch the two edges of the tape.
Brake in front of the gate
When passing through the gate, the horizontal speed must be ≤120 units/s. There is a speedometer to adjust the brakes; Missed port repeater.
Passed all 4 in the opening attempt.
The ice split into 2 pieces after the crack line; may pulse before rupture. Fragment only gives birth to one generation.
The core is in the non-slip section between the two conveyor belts; gain momentum then brake, there are 6 cores according to schedule.
Collect 3 crores in the first 3 opportunities.
Phase swing gate, pick-up point indicator; predict future positions instead of chasing current points.
Slow stone arch has a short path and an outer ring. If you slip too much, it\'s easy to hit the edge of the short road. There\'s still enough time for the detour.
Load 2 stations, go through the last gate
The conveyor belt pushes the battery, not the train; Prediction of pick-up point and stopping route separates observation/control.
Foreshadows the slot chain. The mist only covers the background/decoration, does not cover the hitbox/warning bar; with repeating symbols.
Through each gate, the old lane closes after 2 seconds; must be transitioned, with the area about to close and the next area marked.
Do not return to the old lane within 2 seconds of closing signal.
The first two phases are drifting ice, the last two phases are fragmented ice arcs. The core is open in the no-slip zone for all ships to reach.
Did not hit the secondary ice fragment.
Turn on 3 switches, go through the gate
Go through the switch in the train row to open the correct rear door. If you miss, you can repeat it, but you won\'t lose immediately.
Show triangle–circle–square for 4 seconds then select the correct port. False lets you review and repeat the current item; Avoid relying on color alone.
Horizontal drones have a fixed route, only shoot when the lights are on; Read the stem direction to guess the slot.
The shadow reflects the broken line, the real gate is a solid frame + alarm sound. Reduced drop shadow movement but kept distinguishing symbols.
Do not touch the fake port area.
The transmitter opens to receive the pulse for 6 seconds and then covers the armor; duty pin level before, miss is tried next cycle.
Turn off all 3 when the window has ≥3s remaining.
Three types mixed together: separate targets, normal items, warning mines. Must classify instead of scooping up everything.
Do not pick up parts of the wrong type.
Through 4 gates, open the last gate
Free long distance; Shortcut costs 40 NL but saves time. The last port needs 60, has a compensation pin to avoid hard locking.
Drone follows columns, arcs, diagonals, and drifts at deflection cycle. Next model, don\'t throw all four at the same time.
After 1 cycle, four samples do not pulse.
Gather the components then return to the station lane to open the gate. The station only receives when there are enough cores; There is a bypass to wait for the battery.
Correctly solve the one-core open symbol route. The final phase reverses the order but displays a new sample before running.
Do not choose the wrong phase symbols.
Two thrusts following the arrow, the drift speed is less than the compensating ability of the slowest ship.
Do not touch the wind edge.
The neutral zone passes through 3 lanes, without being pushed in the center. Only counted when passing through the center at the train row.
Big rocks are slow, small rocks are fast, mines drift on different levels; read order to train instead of simple distance.
A pulse that destroys objects on all 3 floors.
Wind pushes the ship and batteries by a different factor; There is a pick-up point line, do not accelerate the battery suddenly. Total 7 opportunities.
Collect 4 pins in the first 4 chances.
Background flash indicates sequence, replaced by static symbol when motion is reduced. Danger only appears after a waiting period.
The pressure area is brought to the middle and then the edge is opened; Need to leave the middle before closing, give 2s warning.
Change the wind to save the ship
The wind does not affect you; Anticipate rocks drifting into your lane and destroy them first with a pulse.
You don\'t lose armor due to rocks drifting sideways.
8s normal recovery / 4s lock recovery, still receiving battery. HUD clearly states locked. Having an optional battery gives enough opportunity for stars.
Report slot sample first; signal at rest beats 2 and 5. Remember to rest to receive, not just chase the gate.
Received two signals the first time.
Left wind, right wind, storm center, cascading rain in four phases. With the core open, the wind is reduced to 25% to reach.
Not pushed to the edge by the wind.
Pulse breaking the button in the middle of the V to open a shortcut; or go beyond the wing further but without the need for a pulse.
Destroy 3 buttons in the middle of the squad.
Drone marks the lane and then fires after 1.8 seconds; Guide the bullets into the old lane and change rhythmically.
Leading 6 series into the same empty lane.
Each package has 2 drones to guard and select pulses or small slots according to the ship. There are 5 packages, the entrance is not locked.
Collect enough without destroying the surveillance drone.
Fake nose with broken lines does not cause damage; Real gate after slow blow. The law of diversion is taught, not fake system notifications.
Do not switch to the decoy lane.
The button reaches the pulse range at a different time; There is an intersection point enough to turn off 2 nodes with one pulse. Sufficient duty battery.
A pulse turns off 2 nodes at intersection.
The enemy blocks your future route. Change early so your friends can follow; Each port has 2 valid exit paths.
You pass through enough gates without losing armor.
The loop is only closed on the upper half; Exit doors take turns at the edge/middle, not at the train row.
Breaking the warehouse reduces pressure but needs to preserve energy for the next beat. Warehouses only count when destroyed, they do not fly off the screen.
Correct 2 pulses for 2 warehouses, no excess presses.
Switch roles every 15 seconds to block lane/guard/sweep; Maximum of 2 roles at the same time.
Pass the lane lock to let the guard separate and expose the core. The last two phases are V-shaped/escape loop; The battery covers each phase separately.
No pulse when core armor is closed.
Report the kicking destination 2 seconds in advance and then kick as predicted. Read the future instead of just looking at the present stone.
Through 6 slots, no pulse is predicted.
Each lane has a different object speed; The train/clock is not slow. Compare train arrival time instead of distance.
The symbol rock moves backwards and then falls back exactly once; Keep the ID/dodge flag close, don\'t reward twice.
4 dodge closely from 4 ID after rewind.
The first door is narrow, the back door is wide. Choose to go early to take advantage or wait to be safer; do not randomly change the door position.
Through ≥3 gates at the first gate.
Sue stops y=560 then continues counting down; Do not pick up before reaching train line. There are 6 chances.
Show string with label “reverse order” before starting; has support for rereading execution order.
The ball records the path 3 seconds before indicating the upcoming shooting position; The ball does not collide. Leave the old path instead of following the ball.
6 shots of the ball did not hit the ship.
The closing pulse only stops the bullet, does not increase the target; wait for the core door. Pin the correct number of times and repeat the error.
You follow real time, threatening to cross the fast/slow zone. Prediction lines help you see which object will reach you first.
No threats from the fast zone reach you.
Five phases: forecast, stop, single rewind, two windows, reverse sequence. Only restores position, does not restore lost boss health.
Do not pulse without opening the core.
Before the screen, choose a wide route with little supply / lots of battery / close avoidance. Leading to the same destination, each route has an aid gate to change if needed.
Do not reroute using the relief gate.
3 stations let you choose battery or shield by lane, not both. The following pattern has two corresponding solutions.
Do not choose the same type at all 3 stations.
The road to rescue cuts the way to protect you; Have the battery before delivery for a general dangerous pulse.
You do not lose armor on two saves.
Four normal sections → wind → ice → forbidden loading, each section has 2 ports. In the middle of neutralization for 3 seconds, do not add drift beyond the limit.
Live for 90 seconds, destroy 4 target clusters
Kicking often causes pressure; The cluster has a shield that opens in rhythm, the pulse must be reserved at the right time. There are 6 target windows.
Do not destroy the dashed pseudo-frame cluster.
Collect 3 locks, pass the last gate
Each lock has a narrow branch to hold combos or a wide branch to load. The choice affects the next phase but does not block the possibility of winning.
Do not use the aid filling station.
3-lane attack priority changes according to the signal; There is a break after the big wave to rotate positions. Do not assume there are already expensive ships.
Sample chapters 2, 3, 5, 7, 9; announced in advance, each junction has clear transfer rules.
Through 6 ports, turn off 2 core locks
Pulse interlocking position gate; battery level before lock. If used by mistake, there is a relief refill ring, not locked.
Done before 85 seconds, do not use the rescue ring.
Three rounds, each round 2 cores: stone/gate; protection/wind; time/armor opening. Rest 5 seconds in between, restore 1 armor/energy level. Terminal phase maximum 2 known mechanisms.
Thang has not activated the life-saving trigger or the relief port; No need to own Sentinel.
Electromagnetic region: using and holding energy
Mechanical ruins: machine reading and decoding
Time Rift: read the rules of change
Balance, no secondary rules; Standard verification of every screen. Trade-off: No specialization.
Quick lane change, small body. Trade-off: Less armor.
Suffers many odd collisions. Trade-offs: Big, slow, slow loading.
Absorb optional items within 45 units around the ship row. Trade-offs: No forced self-suction/port; big body.
Fast passive charging. Trade-offs: Low armor; Batteries usually only charge 15 instead of 20.
Shields items for an additional 2 seconds. Trade-off: Base pulse is only 160 radius.
After dodging, reduces environmental drift by 50% for 1 second. Trade-off: 4s basic combo window.
Every 25 seconds, restores 1 armor if missing; Maximum 2 times/level, 3 times/infinite. Trade-off: Armor restore items do not recharge.
The impulse pushes normally unbroken rocks 30 units further if there is still an escape route. Trade-off: Post-impulse protection is only 0.45s.
Once/level prevents critical blow, 1 armor remaining, invulnerability for 1 second. Trade-off: Does not prevent loss due to escort/expiration; Does not stack revives.
The first time picking up items every 15 seconds adds 8 energy. Trade-off: Base slow is 1s shorter.
Before the stage choose +1 armor **or** +30 pulse radius. Trade-off: Armor configuration: speed reduced to 680; Pulse configuration: restore NL to 2.6.
Why keep the ship: the number of times it loses armor is not too much
Need to pass the level first
Practice without opening, without receiving money or anything.
Why does ship maintenance only count the number of times it loses armor; Repair does not erase lost times.
Pull to pick up the item, go through the correct gate and use pulse when the core opens.
